sam: Heads up — noticed a ~25% p95 latency regression on Mixtral MoE after yesterday's kernel swap. Seems correlated with higher router hot-shard contention and KV cache churn.
maria: Which kernel swap exactly? cuda/blas/fused-softmax? Any build id or trace?
sam: Build `2026-03-12-rc3` that pulled in fused-softmax+rope-rescale. Quick nvprof excerpt:
```
GPU activities:  CUDA_KERNEL_1  42.3% pick_kernel_for_attention
CUDA_KERNEL_2  31.2% expert_dispatch_cuda
CUDA_KERNEL_3  12.5% kv_cache_eviction
```
Also seeing many fallback logs: `attention: using slow_path_attention (seq_len=1152)`
jin: Our runtime metrics show router.topk_hit_rate dropping from 0.86 -> 0.62 and expert_queue_length spiking. Paste from /metrics/moe/mixtral/pool-a: 
```
router.topk_hit_rate: 0.62
expert_eviction_rate: 0.0047
expert_active_set: 78/128
avg_queue_len: 14.2
```
oliver: I ran a microbench. When `router.top_k=2` throughput + latency are better vs `top_k=4`, but quality (simple perplex) regressed ~0.7%. Maybe the new kernel's softfill/topk interaction is causing imbalance. Proposed quick config to test: 
```
{
  "model": "mixtral-moex",
  "router": {"top_k": 3, "temperature": 1.0, "logit_smoothing": 1e-5},
  "runtime": {"expert_parallelism": 4, "kv_cache_size": 32, "batching": {"dynamic": true, "max_tokens": 8192}}
}
```
nina: Note: we recently changed RoPE scaling constants in the model adapter. Mixtral uses 64 heads with kv_dim=64 per-head. A subtle rescale can alter which attention kernel is picked (aligned vs unaligned). If sequence lengths cross 1024 boundary we drop into the slow path.
sam: Profiler trace shows `pick_kernel_for_attention` spending time deciding fallback because `seq_len>1024` and `head_dim % 32 != 0` for some tensors after quantization. So it's kernel-selection churn, not raw compute.
maria: Suggest two simultaneous mitigations: 1) short-term routing/batching knobs to reduce hotspotting, 2) metric-driven canary with `expert_parallelism` reduced. For (1) try: `batcher.prefer_latency=true`, `max_batch_tokens=4096`. For (2) set `expert_parallelism=4` (was 8).
jin: Also add an eviction backpressure tweak: lower `kv_cache_eviction_threshold` from 0.8 -> 0.6 to keep hot keys sticky. We saw eviction_rate correlate with p95.
oliver: Running A/B canary config: `top_k=3`, `expert_parallelism=4`, `kv_cache_size=32`, batching dynamic max_tokens=4096. Command: 
```
redwoodctl runtime update --pool pool-a --model mixtral-moex \
  --set router.top_k=3 --set runtime.expert_parallelism=4 \
  --set runtime.kv_cache_size=32 --set batching.max_tokens=4096
```
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for pool-a at 2799991600 — version mixtral-moex@canary-2799991600. Routing policy: prefer-canary=20%. :satellite:
nina: I'll watch router metrics and flame graphs. If topk_hit_rate recovers and avg_queue_len drops < 6 within 10m, we promote. If not, rollback. Also pushing a small kernel fallback patch that avoids mis-detecting head alignment — if canary fails we can backport.
sam: Thanks — will attach a lightweight perf harness and a few seq_len=512/1024/1152 traces in the canary job. Also adding `--trace dispatcher` to capture `expert_dispatch_cuda` latencies.
maria: FYI leaving short-term alert: p95 latency > 1.25x baseline for 5m => auto rollback canary.
jin: Adding a quick note: if we reduce `expert_parallelism`, watch for increased per-expert load leading to hot keys; counterbalance with slightly higher `router.top_k` if necessary.
oliver: Good point. Will iterate quickly. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
